subject: programming_c
overview: Master C programming from syntax basics to system-level programming. Learn to write efficient, low-level code, understand memory management, and master advanced programming techniques used in embedded systems and systems programming.

beginner.name: Beginner
beginner.prerequisites: Basic computer literacy and problem-solving skills
beginner.outcomes: Strong foundational knowledge in C syntax and basic programming constructs

intermediate.name: Intermediate
intermediate.description: Application level - Apply concepts to solve problems
intermediate.prerequisites: Completion of all beginner modules with 75%+ average
intermediate.outcomes: Ability to write modular programs with data structures and file operations

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.prerequisites: Completion of all intermediate modules with 75%+ average
advanced.outcomes: Professional-level expertise in systems programming and advanced C techniques

progression_logic: Students must complete all modules in a level with an average quiz score of 75% or higher before advancing to the next level. Each module quiz must be passed with at least 75% to proceed to the next module within the same level.
